profile_text.body:
Celestica Inc. describes itself as a technology leader with deep expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and platform solutions. The company says it engineers, designs and manufactures the backbone of AI and cloud technology, and that it enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud. It states that it helps customers achieve a competitive advantage through a talented team and a strategic global network.

Celestica is a for-profit public company headquartered in Toronto, A6, trading under the ticker CLS. Its SEC Central Index Key is 0001030894. No legal cases are listed for the company.
